what_this_shows: Three independent OCR errors in one block: the unit second is read as 'a' in three cells (0.5s -> 0.5a, 60.0s -> 60.0a), the term 电压切断 (voltage cut-off) becomes 电压倒落, and the row structure is rebuilt with rowspan. Tables must be sent as HTML; the renderer does not accept other table markup. Note the reference transcription scores LOW (0.04) even though it faithfully reproduces the block. The ranking is still right -- it beats the erroneous one by a wide margin -- but the absolute value is not usable as 'this transcription is correct'. The cause has not been established; the renderer lays tables out at a fixed width, so a small source crop and its render differ a lot in scale, but that is a hypothesis, not a finding. Treat this example as the concrete reason to compare candidates against each other rather than against a threshold.
observed_note: Measured once on the reference setup. Scores are not bitwise reproducible, so expect small differences; large ones mean something in your setup differs.
